info.name: Marketplace Nigeria - Complete API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Marketplace Nigeria mobile app integration. Includes all authentication, adverts, user management, payments, messaging, and boost management endpoints.

**Quick Start:**
1. Import this collection
2. Import and select an environment (Local or Production)
3. Run the Login request in Authentication folder
4. Token will be auto-saved - all protected routes will work

**Environments:**
- Local: http://127.0.0.1:8030
- Production: https://www.marketplace.ng
